messages:
maria: Hey - after yesterday's IDP migration my team (acme-corp) can't create projects in the console. The Create project button either greys out or returns a 403. Not seeing any obvious role change on the user side.
sam: Can you paste quick repro steps? Is this only the web UI or the API too?
maria: UI + API. Repro:
1) Login via SSO (Okta -> Azure migration)
2) Go to org > New project > Fill name > Create
-> UI greys out then snackbar: 'Permission denied (403)'
Tried the API with our personal token:
```
POST /api/v1/projects
Authorization: Bearer <id_token>
Body: {"name":"test-project"}
Response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","reason":"user lacks project_admin role"}
```
sam: Did you check the id_token claims? `roles` or `groups` claim might not be mapped the same post-migration.
alex: Also confirm SCIM group mapping. If SCIM created the account but role mapping changed names, the console checks for `rbac:project_admin` claim we expect.
maria: I inspected token in jwt.io — group claim contains `acme-project-admins` but the console needs `project_admin` in `app_roles` claim. That's odd because pre-migration it worked.
james: Thanks — this looks like an IDP claim-name mismatch. Quick workaround: I can add you as project_admin via the Admin API if you need immediate access.
If you want to try a local repro for engineering: grab an id_token from the failing login and run:
```
GET /internal/v1/whoami
Authorization: Bearer <id_token>
```
Should return your claims; paste them (masking PII) and we'll confirm.
eng-identity-bot: SCIM sync completed at 2025-02-12T15:20:12Z for acme-corp (batch 2025-02-12-08). No errors logged.
maria: Pasted masked claims in DM to @james: `sub: 0xabc..., app_roles: [], groups: ["acme-project-admins"]`
james: Looks like `app_roles` is empty. Console RBAC checks `app_roles` for direct role assignments and SCIM mapping should populate that. Two options:
- Short-term: I can assign `project_admin` via Admin API for the org (workaround)
- Medium-term: Eng identity team needs to change the claim mapping (map `groups` -> `app_roles` or configure a transform) or update our SCIM bridge to map group->role
james: I'll escalate to eng-identity and open a support ticket with logs + sample id_token. Tagging @eng-identity.
eng-identity: pinged. Can you share the last 8 chars of the failing id_token so we can find it in our logs? Also include the user's email and org id.
maria: Last 8 chars: `...9f7a1b2c`. Org: `org_0234`, user email masked DM'd.
eng-identity: Found the login in logs; SCIM delivered groups but our transform filter dropped them due to a new claim-policy. Creating a rollback plan for the transform and a fix to map legacy group names -> app_roles. Will update in the ticket.
maria: Appreciate it — can you apply the Admin-API workaround on my account in the meantime? We have a demo at 17:00 PST.
james: Will do now and confirm when it's live. :thumbsup:
james: Done — you should be able to create projects now. Please verify and close this thread.
maria: Confirmed, I can create projects. Thanks everyone. :tada:
